transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you in to see me today?

Well, um... thank you for seeing me. I hope I'm not taking up too much of your time. I'm just here because... well, things have been a little stressful at work lately. I'm the chief executive, so there's always pressure, but recently it's been... I don't know, maybe I'm just overworking myself? 

I've been having these moments where I... I hear things. Like people talking about me. Usually, it sounds like the board members or some of my staff, and it's coming through the conference room walls, or even from my phone when it's completely turned off. They're saying things like I'm ruining the company. It's probably just stress, right? But it sounds so incredibly clear that sometimes I actually answer them out loud... before I realize that no one else in the room heard anything. 

I'm sorry, does that sound crazy? I really don't want to seem like I can't handle my job, I just... I wanted to make sure I'm doing the right thing by getting it checked out. Is that okay?
About how long ago did you first start hearing these voices?

Well, um... it hasn't been too long, really. I promise it's not like I've been dealing with this forever. It's just been for about... maybe the past three months? That's when the voices from the walls and my phone started happening. 

But it's been a really heavy quarter at work, so three months makes sense for a stress reaction, right? I hope I didn't wait too long to tell someone... I just wanted to see if it would go away on its own before I bothered a doctor with it. Is three months an okay time to come in?
Over these past three months, have you been feeling persistently down, sad, or depressed?

No, no, I wouldn't say I've been depressed at all. I mean, sure, it's been stressful, like I said, and nobody likes hearing people say they're ruining things... but I'm not sitting around crying or feeling hopeless or anything like that. 

I actually still have a lot of energy for my work. I love my job, I really do. I just... I just want to figure out how to handle the stress better so I can keep being effective, you know? I'm not a sad person, I promise. Does that make sense? I hope I'm explaining it right.
Have you been diagnosed with any medical conditions, or experienced any physical health issues recently?

No, I... I haven't been sick at all. My physical health is actually really good. I make sure to take care of myself, you know, eating right and getting enough sleep when I can. I haven't had any medical conditions diagnosed or... or any weird physical issues lately. 

I'm perfectly healthy in that regard, I promise. I wouldn't want you to think I'm neglecting my health or anything. I just go for my regular check-ups and everything is always fine. Is that what you were looking for? I hope that's helpful.
